name: Waldorf Astoria Park City
insider_take: This alpine luxury haven sits at 7,000 feet elevation, where Olympic legends were made and powder dreams come true year-round.
whats_special: Built just steps from the 2002 Winter Olympics venues, this Waldorf Astoria occupies prime real estate on Park City Mountain Resort's base. The hotel features ski-in/ski-out access to over 7,300 acres of terrain, plus Utah's famous champagne powder that averages 355 inches annually. The rooftop pool and hot tubs offer stunning views of the Wasatch Mountains while heated year-round.
pro_tip: Book during shoulder seasons (late March-April or November) for 40% savings and easier access to Park City's renowned restaurants along Historic Main Street, just a 5-minute complimentary shuttle ride away.
dont_miss: The exclusive Waldorf Astoria Spa's signature "High Altitude Recovery" treatment using locally-sourced botanicals, and sunset drinks at the rooftop bar with panoramic views of the Olympic Park's ski jumps. In summer, the area transforms into a mountain biking paradise with lift-accessed trails and the famous Alpine Slide.
pros: Prime ski-in/ski-out location at Canyons Village
Elegant mountain resort accommodations with premium amenities
Multiple dining venues and rooftop terrace with mountain views
cons: Mountain location requires travel to downtown Park City
